jobs.description:
We are looking for an enthusiastic sorting assistant for a company in Zulte that specializes in sorting and distributing clothing!

We are looking for a motivated sorting assistant to join our team.

In this position, you will be responsible for sorting various materials and processing them correctly.

What will you be doing?

• Sorting second-hand clothing into different qualities.
• Working at a good pace – you are dynamic and accurate.
• No allergies to dust and no physical complaints.
• You preferably live nearby or you have a car

What are our expectations?

• Knowledge of Dutch or English is required.
• Willingness to perform physical work.
• You are not allergic to dust!
• You are not colourblind!
• Accuracy and attention to detail.
• You are looking for a long-term job.
• You live close to Zulte or you have a car
• You are motivated and enjoy working in a team.

Are you detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working in a dynamic international environment?

We are looking for a Contract & Order Management Officer to support the commercial operations and ensure the seamless handling of contracts, quotations, and purchase orders.

As part of the team, you will play a key role in supporting the end-to-end contract and order management process by:

• Managing business contracts, including approval workflows and electronic signatures.
• Preparing and processing quotations while helping to standardize and optimize existing processes.
• Reviewing purchase orders for completeness, consistency, and accuracy, and ensuring timely processing and communication.
• Building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders through proactive communication on contract and order status.
• Developing expertise in the business you support, including customer requirements, contractual frameworks, and quotation processes.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in a medium-sized to large organization or a complex business environment.
• Initial experience in contract management, sales administration/support, or a paralegal role.
• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with a focus on quality and accuracy.
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving work environment.
• Comfortable managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines.
• Tech-savvy, with experience using tools such as Microsoft Office, MS Dynamics CRM, and OneDrive.
• Fluent in English

Your future job

As a production operator, you’ll provide support to the press operator during the production process. You’ll make sure that the glue goes into the correct glue tank and closely monitor the glue levels. In addition, you’ll welcome drivers and direct them to the right location.

You’ll also be responsible for maintenance tasks and cleaning the equipment, ensuring everything runs safely and smoothly.

In short: a varied role where you play an important part in keeping the production process efficient and well-organized!

Who are you?

• 
You speak good English and can communicate easily on the work floor.

• 
You’re not afraid of physical work and like to get things done.

• 
You don’t mind getting your hands dirty.

• 
You’re motivated to work in a 6-shift system.

Are you looking for a new challenge that will (fork)lift your spirits? Be sure to read further! 
We are looking for an experienced Forklift Driver for a company specialized in the construction and interior sector. 

What are your tasks? 

• Responsibility of operating the line
• Safely but quickly move goods on and off trucks using a forklift
• Place items in the correct storage locations and stack them securely
• Move pallets and products between the dock, warehouse, and storage areas
• Respect safety rules, wear protective equipment, and ensure a safe working environment

What do we expect from you? 

• You are a motivated candidate who is ready to pick up their new tasks quickly
• You have broad experience as a forklift driver
• You are in possession of a forklift certificate
• You have your own car
• You speak English well
• You are aware of the importance of following health and safety guidelines

As a logistics operator, you are responsible for monitoring and managing logistics processes, resolving malfunctions, performing technical interventions, and working with modern systems in an automated cold storage environment. You work in a two-shift system and have a technical affinity.What will you be doing at Agristo?As a logistics operator, you are responsible for: 
• Monitoring and managing the processes within the logistics department to ensure continuity. 
• Identifying and resolving irregularities and malfunctions in the logistics flows. 
• Carrying out minor technical interventions to ensure a safe and smooth flow of goods. 
• Working with modern systems and operating cranes and shuttles in the automated cold storage facility. 
• Interpreting data trends and reporting process information with the aim of contributing to improvement actions for the logistics department.
 
• You have a technical affinity. 
• You hold a valid forklift and reach truck certificate, or you are willing to obtain one. 
• Working in a colder environment doesn’t scare you, and you are not afraid of heights. 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system (5 a.m. – 1 p.m. and 1 p.m. – 9 p.m.). 
• You are comfortable working with computers and eager to learn new programs. 
• You work efficiently and with respect for safety and quality standards. 
• You have a good command of Dutch, French, or English.

Production | Quality Control | Team Leadership | Rework | 5S | 3-Shift System
 Your new roleAs a Production & Quality Team Leader, you will supervise a team of Operators and Inspectors. You organize the daily workload based on priorities, skills and available capacity, while ensuring that quality and production targets are achieved.
Your new companyYou will join an operational manufacturing environment where quality, safety and efficiency are key. As a Production & Quality Team Leader, you supervise Operators and Inspectors and ensure that production, inspection and rework activities are performed according to the required quality and safety standards.

 
Your responsibilities include:

 Your profile

• Hands-on, communicative and well organized

• Strong focus on quality, safety and operational efficiency

Your Profile

• Strong communication and leadership skills
• Hands-on mindset and comfortable working closely with the shop floor

Are you an Automation Engineer looking to contribute to major industrial projects and help shape the future of manufacturing on an international scale?

Based in Lembeke, you will join the Group Engineering team of a leading international food manufacturer recognised for its strong growth, technological expertise and significant investment in its global production capabilities.

 

Following major investments in new production facilities and the continued expansion of its industrial footprint, the Group is pursuing the development of its manufacturing network worldwide.

As Automation Project Engineer, you will contribute to this ambition by delivering automation projects across both new production facilities and existing plants. You will help deploy advanced technologies, optimise production performance and develop consistent automation standards across the Group. 

 

Your responsibilities

•  Lead automation projects from concept to commissioning
• Lead and/or execute automation engineering projects in collaboration with local engineering, maintenance and production teams.
• Manage the full project lifecycle, from requirements definition and concept development to budgeting, tendering, detailed engineering, implementation, commissioning and aftercare.
• Contribute to major CAPEX investments, including new production facilities and greenfield projects, as well as the modernisation and revamping of existing production lines.
• Coordinate external engineering partners, suppliers and technical specialists when required.
• Ensure projects meet agreed technical specifications, quality standards, budgets and timelines.
• Identify potential technical challenges and work with relevant stakeholders to develop practical, reliable solutions.
•  Support an international manufacturing network
• Understand site-specific requirements and translate them into robust, efficient automation solutions.
• Support the integration and deployment of automation systems across different production environments.
• Coordinate with local teams to ensure that project solutions meet operational needs and can be effectively implemented on site.
• Share technical expertise, lessons learned and best practices across the Group's international network.
• Travel internationally when required to support project execution, installation and commissioning.
•  Develop automation expertise and standards at Group level
• Act as a technical sparring partner for plant teams, suppliers and external specialists.
• Provide technical guidance on complex automation topics and equipment integration.
• Contribute to the development and maintenance of Group-wide automation standards, guidelines and working procedures.
• Promote structured project management practices and the consistent application of technical standards.
• Help ensure that automation solutions are reliable, maintainable and aligned with the Group's long-term industrial development.
•  Explore new technologies and drive continuous improvement
• Stay up to date with developments in industrial automation, digitalisation, Industry 4.0, food manufacturing technology and packaging equipment.
• Identify opportunities to improve production performance, equipment reliability, flexibility and maintainability.
• Evaluate new technologies and assess their practical application within the Group's manufacturing environment.
• Contribute to the selection and implementation of innovative automation solutions.

Your profile

You hold a Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering or a related technical discipline, combined with a minumum of 3 years of experience in industrial automation.

You combine strong technical knowledge with a structured, hands-on approach to project delivery and the ability to work effectively with different stakeholders across an international organisation.

Your experience and skills include:

• Experience in industrial manufacturing, ideally in a production environment.
• Strong knowledge of PLCs and industrial automation systems, with hands-on experience with Rockwell and/or Siemens PLCs.
• Familiarity with HMI, SCADA and industrial control systems.
• Experience managing or contributing to CAPEX projects, equipment integration, new installations or production-line revamping.
• A good understanding of the interfaces between automation, electrical, mechanical and production systems.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex technical challenges into clear, practical solutions.
• An interest in new technologies, digitalisation and continuous improvement.
• A structured and hands-on approach, combined with the ability to work autonomously and take ownership of projects.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across different functions, sites and cultures.
• Professional fluency in Dutch & English; additional languages are an asset.
• Willingness to travel internationally in line with project requirements

Your future job

You’ll also be responsible for maintenance tasks and cleaning the equipment, ensuring everything runs safely and smoothly.

In short: a varied role where you play an important part in keeping the production process efficient and well-organized!

jobs.description:
Job description 

Welcome to the wonderful world of truck drivers! You will hit the road with an impressive tractor-trailer combination. Waking up early is essential, as you will be leaving between 5 and 7 in the morning. Don't worry, you are allowed to work around 12 hours a day, which is more than enough time to make the asphalt disappear under your fantastic vehicle. Of course, you are a true adventurer, so crossing a border occasionally doesn't faze you. Fortunately, most of it is national work, so you won't need an international driving license.

You will make between 4 to 6 stops a day, which means you will spend a lot of time on the road. Naturally, as a superhero driver with a CE license, you will be responsible for loading, transporting, and delivering various goods. Do you have experience with a fork truck (kooiaap)? Then you have an advantage. But don't panic if that's not the case, because you can still receive training for it internally. And if you're a true night owl, you can also take night trips for this position. The choice is yours! Just let us know.

 Requirements 

    
• Driver's license: CE + code 95.
    
• Knowledge of Dutch, French, or English.

Job description 

Looking for freedom and your own dedicated truck (after your onboarding period)? This is your route:

    
• 
        
What: National transport (tipper and curtain-sider) of steel and miscellaneous materials.

    
    
• 
        
When: Early mornings (start between 4 AM and 6 AM) for a full 10-12 hour day.

    
    
• 
        
How: Independently, punctually, and in close contact with dispatch.

    

 Requirements 

    
• 
        
Valid CE license + Code 95.

    
    
• 
        
Speaks Dutch, French, or English.

    
    
• 
        
An early bird who loves working independently and accurately.

    
    
• 
        
An honest team player who cares for the equipment and the customer.

• Define and manage the integrated project plan, including scope, deliverables, budget, resources, risks, dependencies, quality and acceptance criteria

• Lead projects involving cloud services, HPC platforms, secure compute environments, infrastructure modernization, integrations and migration.

• Coordinate agreement on service ownership, support responsibilities, acceptance criteria and the operational model.

• Strong planning, organization, coordination and risk-management skills, with a pragmatic and outcome-oriented mindset.

• Ability to translate between business or research needs and technical, security and operational realities.

• Understanding of cloud, HPC, infrastructure and secure environments to coordinate specialists, challenge plans and identify delivery risks.

• Experience with cloud adoption, platform modernization, compute-intensive or highly secure environments is an advantage (8+ years)

You'll join a close-knit team of approximately 15 colleagues where communication lines are short and everyone knows each other. In the workshop, you'll work closely with Hendrik, the experienced workshop manager, and a fellow technician. Hendrik has years of experience in the trade and enjoys sharing that knowledge with you. He values quality and craftsmanship but is also open to discussion and good collaboration.

No two days are the same. You'll work on a modern fleet of diesel and electric buses, ensuring our customers can travel safely and worry-free.

You'll be responsible for:

• Preparing new vehicles delivered directly from the factory

• Performing maintenance and repair work on both diesel and electric buses

• Diagnosing and resolving electrical and electronic faults using diagnostic equipment and software

• Mechanical repairs including brakes, suspension, drivetrain and other technical components

• Carrying out interventions and emergency repairs when needed

Are you a technician who thrives on variety and technical challenges?

• You are comfortable working with diagnostic techniques and electronic systems.

• You are eager to learn and grow in the field of electric vehicles.

Nice to have:

For one of our clients, a company specialising in the petrochemical sector and located in the centre of Brussels, we are looking for a Customer Service Officer. 

As a Customer Service Officier you will be responsible for the management of daily operations in the Customer Service Department and work closely together with 2 Sales Representatives. In general he/she is the interface for the different services within the organization and will specialized for commercial and marketing topics.

Your responsibilities as a Customer Service Officer :

Customers :* Handle requests and claims from customers by phone and by email;* Contracts & files : check input, rebates & additional services contracts;* Follow-up marketing actions decided by the Benelux Country Manager;* Order of new customer cards and toll box;* Follow-up portfolio of customers;* Help train the customers to use autonomously extranet, customer portal etc.

General administration :* Mails (post) and the e-mails on the general mailbox;* Sales support for the sales representatives : invoice, edit credit notes, etc;* Reporting activities;* Back-up of colleagues (customer service, sales officer).

Network :* Administrative help to Technical Manager;* Manual acceptance authorization;* Follow up of fraud cases in stations;* Resolve and help customers on issues related to cards and tolls.

The ideal profile of a Customer Service Officer :* You have a perfect command of Dutch, both spoken and written. You also have a very good knowledge of French, both spoken and written. Knowledge of English is an asset.* You have initial experience in Customer Service, Customer Care or file management.* You have a good knowledge of IT tools (MS Office) and are familiar with CRM systems.* You are an organised person, you are willing to take initiative and you have good customer relations skills.* You can easily switch between different tasks and have strong communication skills.
